seed_semantics: deterministic arithmetic price paths, not random sampling

time_model.signal: after session close using that session close and earlier closes only
time_model.execution: pending target executes at the next available session open
time_model.final_session: target remains pending because no future execution session exists

result_model_boundary: This fixture is an event ledger with explicit fills, cash, holdings, costs and NAV. A Vector candidate uses a separately declared target-weight × return model and is compared only under shared assumptions; the Vector result is not asserted to be this account ledger.
